about: .XN--KPUT3I is a generic top-level domain (gTLD) delegated in the DNS root zone. The registry operator responsible for .XN--KPUT3I is listed by IANA as Beijing RITT-Net Technology Development Co., Ltd. Anyone can typically register a .XN--KPUT3I name through an accredited registrar, subject to the registry’s registration policy and ICANN consensus policies.
